properties.address: Ptge. del Regent Mendieta, 5, Les Corts, 08028 Barcelona
properties.info: Onefam Les Corts is in the residential neighbourhood of Les Corts, next to Camp Nou and one metro stop from the Eixample, so it suits travellers who want a quieter base and a taste of a local Barcelona neighbourhood away from the tourist crowds. The chain says it has over 100 beds in shared and private rooms. The common lounge has a TV, a PlayStation and a pool table, and the rooftop terrace has sun loungers and tables under umbrellas. There is a strong local café scene nearby, and the hostel runs the usual Onefam social programme of walking tours, bar crawls and group dinners. Reception is open 24 hours, check-in is from 14:00, lockers are provided and luggage can be stored free on arrival and departure days. Onefam says the hostel scores 9.7 on Hostelworld, and it offers its best rates when you book direct on the Onefam website.

properties.name: ONEFAM PARALELO
properties.address: Carrer de Salvà, 62, Sants-Montjuïc, 08004 Barcelona
properties.info: Onefam Paralelo is in Poble Sec, near Avinguda del Paral·lel, a lively neighbourhood of local tapas bars that is less touristy than the Old Town. Montjuïc is five minutes uphill, Las Ramblas about ten minutes on foot and the beach a 15-minute walk or one metro stop away. The chain describes it as the most social of its five Barcelona hostels, with bar crawls leaving weekly and a rooftop terrace that becomes a meeting point every evening. Guests can relax in the common areas, meet other travellers and join the usual Onefam programme of walking tours and group dinners. Reception is open 24 hours, check-in is from 14:00, lockers are provided and luggage can be stored free on arrival and departure days. Onefam says the hostel scores 9.7 on Hostelworld. It is a good pick for travellers who want local bars, Montjuïc and the beach within easy reach.

properties.name: SANT JORDI HOSTELS ROCK PALACE
properties.address: Carrer de Balmes, 75, Eixample, 08007 Barcelona
properties.info: Rock Palace is the rock-and-roll hostel of the Sant Jordi chain, at Carrer Balmes 75, five minutes on foot from Passeig de Gràcia and Casa Batlló and ten from Plaça Catalunya, the Gothic Quarter and La Pedrera. Its common areas are styled after the bars and clubs that shaped modern music, with a guitar collection, a famous bar and a rooftop terrace with a pool. Dorms are mixed or female, from four to fourteen beds, and many are en suite; every bed has a large locker opened by the key card, a reading lamp, a charging point and a headboard cubby, and the rooms are soundproofed and air conditioned. Facilities include a 24-hour reception, free Wi-Fi, guest computers, a guest kitchen, laundry, luggage storage and bike and skate rental. Check-in is from 14:00, check-out is until 11:00, a refundable 10 euro key-card deposit applies, and quiet hours start at 23:00. Registered as AJ000593.

properties.name: ONEFAM SANTS HOSTEL BARCELONA
properties.address: Carrer de Casteràs, 9, Sants-Montjuïc, 08028 Barcelona
properties.info: Onefam Sants stands directly beside Barcelona Sants, the city's main intercity train and bus station, which makes it a practical choice for late arrivals, early departures and day trips. Girona, Montserrat, Tarragona and the Costa Brava are all under an hour away by rail, and the city centre is three metro stops away. The hostel's selling points are a spacious rooftop terrace with panoramic views and a chill-out lounge with a pool table, and the chain describes it as a cosy, authentic place for backpackers. Guests share the usual Onefam social programme of walking tours, bar crawls and group dinners. Reception is open 24 hours, check-in is from 14:00, lockers are provided and luggage can be stored free on arrival and departure days. Onefam says the hostel scores 9.7 on Hostelworld and that dorm beds are cheapest when booked direct on its own site.

properties.name: ONEFAM BATLLÓ
properties.address: Carrer de Casanova, 52, Loc 1, Eixample, 08011 Barcelona
properties.info: Onefam Batlló is a cosy hostel in the Eixample, steps from Casa Batlló on Passeig de Gràcia and at the intersection of two of Barcelona's metro lines. The Sagrada Família is one stop away and the Barceloneta beach about 20 minutes on foot, which makes it a convenient base for Gaudí's modernist landmarks. The chain pitches it as a home away from home for backpackers after an authentic experience, with a relaxed, social atmosphere. Guests get free Wi-Fi, a fully equipped shared kitchen and regular events to meet other travellers, including walking tours, bar crawls and group dinners. Reception is open 24 hours and each bed has a locker. Check-in is from 14:00 and free luggage storage is offered on arrival and departure days. Onefam says all five of its Barcelona hostels score 9.7 to 9.8 on Hostelworld, and Batlló is one of the two at 9.8.

properties.name: SANT JORDI HOSTELS SAGRADA FAMILIA
properties.address: Carrer del Freser, 5, Sant Martí, 08026 Barcelona
properties.info: Sant Jordi Hostels Sagrada Familia is the chain's skateboard hostel, at Carrer Freser 5, with a skating theme that reflects Barcelona's street art, urban culture and nightlife, and an indoor skate room with a mini-ramp. It is a ten-minute walk from the Sagrada Família, and two metro lines, L2 and L5, are five minutes away, with three night bus lines less than three blocks from the door. Dorms range from three to twelve beds, mixed or female, many with private bathrooms, plus a triple private room; each bed has a locker, a reading lamp and a charging point, and rooms are air conditioned. There is a large guest kitchen, a lounge, a private patio, guest computers, free Wi-Fi, laundry, luggage storage, a 24-hour reception and bike and skate rental. The hostel runs daily activities and nights out, and warns that it is a party hostel, recommending its Gràcia hostel for something mellower. Registered as AJ000517.

properties.name: ONEFAM RAMBLAS HOSTEL BARCELONA
properties.address: Carrer d'Albareda, 6, Sants-Montjuïc, 08004 Barcelona
properties.info: Onefam Ramblas sits in the Old Town, steps from Las Ramblas, the Gothic Quarter and the city's main sights, with the beach, the cathedral and the harbour all within a 15-minute walk. It is one of five Onefam hostels in Barcelona, a chain that says its Barcelona hostels score 9.7 to 9.8 on Hostelworld. Guests get free high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped shared kitchen, a common lounge made for meeting other travellers, lockers and a 24-hour reception. The weekly social programme includes a free walking tour, a bar crawl and group dinners. Dorms use keycard access. Check-in is from 14:00, with earlier check-in from 10:00 on request if a room is free, and luggage can be stored free from 08:00 on arrival day. Towels can be rented. It is billed as the best base for first-timers who want to walk everywhere, and it takes bookings direct on the Onefam website.

properties.info: Sant Jordi Hostels Gràcia is the chain's calmer, boutique hostel, at Carrer de Terol 35 in the Gràcia district, which the hostel calls the hippest neighbourhood in Barcelona, full of squares, bars, restaurants, art studios, theatres and independent shops, and well connected to the centre by metro line 3 and bus. All rooms are air conditioned mixed or female dorms for four to eight people with shared bathrooms, and each bed has a locker that needs no padlock, a reading lamp and a charging point. There is a fully equipped guest kitchen, a rooftop and an interior patio, laundry, towels, guest computers, free Wi-Fi, luggage storage, a 24-hour reception, daily cleaning and bike and skate rental. The hostel describes its atmosphere as young but calm, suited to solo travellers and small groups, and sends party seekers to its Sagrada Família hostel. Registered as AJ000535.

properties.info: Hostelfly Fira Barcelona is a hostel at Carrer d'Enric Morera 58 in L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, next to Gran Via and very close to the Fira Barcelona exhibition grounds, so it works as a convenient base for trade fairs, events, work trips and group getaways as well as city breaks. It describes its offer as shared rooms with a private bathroom, common areas for day-to-day use and services meant to make the stay smooth from arrival. The building has a lift, a lounge and a swimming pool, and it is part of the Hostelfly group, which also runs a hostel near Madrid airport and promotes free cancellation and a best-price guarantee on its own website. Reservations can be made online, and the hostel can be contacted by phone or email. Check the Booking.com and Hostelworld listings for room types, rates and recent guest reviews before you book.

properties.info: Hola Hostel Eixample is at Carrer de Nàpols 149 in the Eixample district of Barcelona, and its own site describes it as a comfortable, dynamic and modern place to stay for travellers who value a great location, well-maintained shared spaces and an atmosphere for relaxing, socialising and getting around the city easily. It has air conditioning, heating and Wi-Fi, a kitchen and dining area with a TV, and a games corner with a foosball table and sofa, and shared rooms include a mixed eight-person dormitory with lockers and a mix of single and bunk beds. The site promises the best online price and free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival when you book direct, and the hostel is registered with the Catalan youth-hostel registry as number 575. properties.info: 360 Hostel Centro is a social hostel at Carrer de Bailèn 7 in central Barcelona, a few blocks from Plaça Catalunya, La Rambla and Passeig de Gràcia, with the Old Town next door and the Sagrada Família and the beach within walking distance. It has a big communal lounge with sofas and a large, fully equipped kitchen with a stove, microwave, toaster, fridge, pots and pans. Dorms sleep four, six or eight, and there is a two-bed room with its own terrace; every room has free lockers, reading lights, air conditioning and linen. Reception is open 24 hours, check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is before 11:00, and free Wi-Fi covers the building. The young staff run a free walking tour every day and a different activity each night, such as paella night, free sangria and tapas, pasta night and a pub crawl. Towels can be hired and laundry costs extra. The hostel is wheelchair accessible.

properties.info: 360 Hostel Borne is at Ronda de Sant Pere 56, beside the El Borne neighbourhood, known for arts and culture, nightlife and restaurants, and a few blocks from Plaça Catalunya, La Rambla and Passeig de Gràcia. The hostel says it was awarded best hostel in the world for solo travellers, and it combines some calm with daily activities such as walking tours, free dinners and nights out. Its rooms are described as very spacious: a two-bed room with a private terrace and dorms of six, eight and twelve beds, all with free lockers, reading lights, air conditioning and linen. There is a well-equipped kitchen and a big terrace for the Barcelona sun. Reception is open 24 hours, check-in is from 14:00 and check-out is before 11:00, with free Wi-Fi throughout. Towels can be hired and laundry costs extra. Wheelchair access is listed among its facilities, and a pub crawl runs most nights.
